plugin.description: A native GitHub contribution calendar for your Noctalia bar.
plugin.name: GitHub Activity

show_best_streak.description: Show the longest contribution streak below the calendar.
show_best_streak.label: Show best streak

show_current_streak.description: Show the current contribution streak below the calendar.
show_current_streak.label: Show current streak

show_profile_button.description: Show the button for opening the GitHub profile.
show_profile_button.label: Show profile button

show_today.description: Show the contribution count for today below the calendar.
show_today.label: Show today's contributions

show_year_total.description: Show the annual contribution total when no calendar day is selected.
show_year_total.label: Show annual total

refresh_interval.description: How often GitHub contribution data refreshes automatically.
refresh_interval.label: Refresh interval

widget_display_metric.description: Choose the contribution metric shown next to the GitHub icon.
widget_display_metric.label: Widget metric

widget_display_mode.description: Choose whether this widget shows only the GitHub icon or also a numeric value.
widget_display_mode.label: Widget display
